title: NoFomo
tagline: Yield-bearing chained limit orders for multi-chain portfolio management.
description:
NoFomo is the ultimate automated portfolio manager designed for crypto holders, not day traders. Emotions like FOMO and fear constantly ruin trading strategies, and standard limit orders demand manual attention while leaving your capital sitting idle. We built NoFomo to completely remove emotions and constant chart-watching from the equation.
We solve this by introducing Chained Limit Orders. The exact moment you buy a token, you can attach a full selling strategy template (like a complex sell grid) with one click. You set it once, and walk away. While your orders wait to hit their targets, our Earn Module automatically aggregates yield through staking and lending protocols, ensuring your idle capital is always working for you before and after the swap.
Furthermore, NoFomo features a Keyless AI Agent Architecture. Giving an AI your private keys is a massive security risk. Instead, our AI acts strictly as a deterministic configurator. It monitors the market, suggests portfolio rebalancing, and finds better yield opportunities. It prepares the optimal path, but your private keys remain safely outside the agent, securely signing only pre-agreed rules. With multi-chain support and access to tokenized stocks, NoFomo gives you one unified portfolio. Kill the FOMO, automate the logic
how_its_made:
We built NoFomo's architecture around a unique "Keyless AI" concept. We used OpenClaw and Hermes, but not in the traditional, risky way of giving an AI access to private keys. Instead, they serve strictly as strategy configurators. The AI pieces together deterministic building blocks (like chained limit orders) and outputs a configuration. The user's private keys remain completely isolated outside the agent, securely signing only these pre-agreed rules. This is our most notable "hacky" feature: completely removing AI hallucination risks and saving users' capital from rogue trades.
For the execution and routing layer, we pieced together two main partner technologies:
1. Uniswap API & Robinhood Tokenized Stocks: We integrated the Uniswap API as a core routing engine for our strategies. Crucially, we used the API to fetch quotes and execute swaps not just for standard crypto tokens, but specifically for Robinhood tokenized stocks. This allowed our AI configurator to seamlessly build automated exit strategies and portfolio rebalancing that includes traditional equities, all within one unified interface.
2. Sui Network & Cetus DEX: To handle fast, multi-chain execution without high gas bottlenecks, we built on the Sui Testnet. We integrated with the Cetus DEX smart contracts to manage the actual swapping logic on the Sui ecosystem. In our implementation, we successfully tested and routed automated chained orders using hbtc through the Cetus pools. Sui's architecture provided the perfect low-latency environment needed to instantly trigger our chained limit orders the moment a price target was hit.
